SEPARATION AGREEMENT AND GENERAL RELEASE

This Separation Agreement and General Release ("Agreement") is entered into between
Acme Robotics, Inc. ("Company") and Jordan Rivera ("Employee"), effective January 15, 2026.

1. Severance Payment
The Company will pay the Employee a severance amount of $42,500.00, less applicable
withholdings, within 30 days of the Effective Date.

2. Release of Claims
The Employee releases the Company from all claims arising on or before the date of this
Agreement, including any claims under federal, state, or local law.

3. Consideration Period and Revocation
The Employee has 21 days to consider this Agreement and 7 days after signing to revoke it.
Questions may be directed to hr@acmerobotics.example.

4. Non-Disparagement
The Employee agrees not to make disparaging statements about the Company or its officers.

5. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
